checks.name: 15 source-scoped families, acyclic forward forms and incarnation separation
exact-source compatibility contract binds every engine, profile and graph input
legacy CQC globals and ordinary combat are byte-for-byte behavior preserved
eligibility queries have no side effects and full-health forms never change automatically
frame, health, meter, neutral ground and active object conditions each block independently
explicit request changes actual fighter profile at the next tick without healing or clearing harms
all 17 admitted edges switch to exact UID and preserve finite spent resource capacity
giant, rooted and scene-bound phases cannot be manufactured as free duel actors
no cross-incarnation links, reverse mutation, skip-a-form or equipment-as-mutation
successful recovery consumes exactly 24 ticks and rejects attack/jump while remaining hittable
revalidated queue cancellation and opponent objects do not permit stale commands
simultaneous voluntary mutations keep actor identity, physics and both meter costs
round reset keeps evolved profile while legacy engine resets life under ordinary round rules
natural human duel reaches eligibility and records a real voluntary mutation without state overrides
replay seek before/after mutation reconstructs exact UID, history and final result
corrupted mutation, health injection, wrong engine, invalid run and wrong digest fail closed
R28 and preserved R7 replay parsers reject each other without touching original records
CPU spectator and second-slot mutation requests remain manual and reproducible

notes: Synthetic boundary fixtures test rule safety; separate natural replay scenario changes no actor state.
No official transformation frames, physical controllers or 1:1 world scales certified.
